g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
24:- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and ga
te pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.
41:- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test wit
h local results and an MCPJam identity
52:- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab
CI, and other CI environments
71:- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-suite.md): API reference for EvalSuite
73:- [runSuiteFile](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md): API reference for running an MCPJam suite file local
ly from code
88:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite ru
n from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `r
unId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in th
e hosted UI Runs tab,…
91:- [Compare a run against a baseline](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/compare-a-run-against-a-baseline.md): Comp
are this run against a baseline run: per-case status (`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_case`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scorer pas
s-rate and mean deltas from the evaluation contract, and whether the evaluation config changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare agains
t the nearest earlier **completed**…
96:- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /
projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: "failed_cases"` would execute, before anything spends. The platform sel
ects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded`
count trials; `selectedCase…
97:- [Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-runs-failed-cases.md): Replay a finished
run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that is not completed and passed (cancelle
d and skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases — see the rerun preview. The new run records `rerunOfRunId` and
`rerunScope`, and beca…
98:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest
first.
99:- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytic
s.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-val
ue chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and h
ost.
101:- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-re
port.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.
102:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a
-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its att
ached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environm
ent suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…
104:- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-auth
or-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases — and responds `201` **synchronousl
y**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suite
Id`).
105:- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-e
val-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuit
eId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this b
ody is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…
106:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md):
The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups in
stead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.
107:- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its c
ases. Past runs are not deleted.
108:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partia
l update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (rev
erting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated s
uite.
109:- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclos
ure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it calls and where they route,
which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the subprocessors engaged.
Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…
110:- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the
suite, in the public steps-first shape.
111:- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. B
oth `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but
a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.
112:- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 ca
ses to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files wi
